# Icon

A line icon (Lucide), referenced by name, with a consistent stroke width.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Icons in buttons, list items, menus and empty states; the `icon` field of menu items uses the same names

## Import

```ts
import { Icon } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Referenced by name; the color follows the text color.

```tsx
import { Icon, Inline } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Inline gap={3}>
      <Icon name="folder" />
      <Icon name="messages" />
      <Icon name="users" size={20} />
      <Icon name="alert" label="Warning" />
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `IconName` | Icon name, see `iconNames` (only registered icons can be used). | — | Yes |
| `size` | `number` | Size in pixels, 16 by default. | — | No |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Stroke width, 1.75 by default (thin but crisp). | — | No |
| `tone` | `'inherit' \| 'secondary' \| 'tertiary' \| 'accent' \| 'danger' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | Color: `inherit` follows the text color (default); the others are semantic colors. State colors such as hover and selected are controlled by the surrounding element. | `'inherit'` | No |
| `label` | `string` | Text label for meaningful icons; omit it for purely decorative icons (hidden from screen readers). | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

Values: `"search"`, `"link"`, `"at"`, `"sort"`, `"filter"`, `"user"`, `"sparkles"`, `"file-text"`, `"activity"`, `"aperture"`, `"archive"`, `"arrow-left"`, `"arrow-down"`, `"arrow-right"`, `"arrow-up"`, `"ban"`, `"banknote"`, `"bell"`, `"bell-off"`, `"book"`, `"bot"`, `"braces"`, `"brain"`, `"briefcase"`, `"building"`, `"calendar"`, `"chart"`, `"check"`, `"chevron-down"`, `"chevron-left"`, `"chevron-right"`, `"alert"`, `"check-circle"`, `"circle-dashed"`, `"x-circle"`, `"approval"`, `"clock"`, `"code"`, `"columns"`, `"command"`, `"contact"`, `"copy"`, `"enter"`, `"crown"`, `"database"`, `"download"`, `"more"`, `"external-link"`, `"file"`, `"file-archive"`, `"file-audio"`, `"file-code"`, `"file-image"`, `"file-video"`, `"eye"`, `"eye-off"`, `"folder"`, `"grip"`, `"folder-open"`, `"project"`, `"handshake"`, `"hard-drive"`, `"hash"`, `"home"`, `"hourglass"`, `"image"`, `"images"`, `"inbox"`, `"info"`, `"kanban"`, `"key"`, `"finance"`, `"layers"`, `"maximize"`, `"dashboard"`, `"grid"`, `"list"`, `"loader"`, `"lock"`, `"logout"`, `"message"`, `"messages"`, `"monitor"`, `"move"`, `"moon"`, `"org"`, `"package"`, `"rows"`, `"palette"`, `"sidebar"`, `"attach"`, `"edit"`, `"pin"`, `"pin-start"`, `"pin-end"`, `"plus"`, `"power"`, `"receipt"`, `"refresh"`, `"reply"`, `"rotate-ccw"`, `"scan-search"`, `"send"`, `"settings"`, `"share"`, `"shield"`, `"smile"`, `"compose"`, `"star"`, `"stop"`, `"sun"`, `"thumbs-down"`, `"thumbs-up"`, `"trash"`, `"truck"`, `"undo"`, `"upload"`, `"user-minus"`, `"user-plus"`, `"users"`, `"wallet"`, `"webhook"`, `"close"`, `"zap"`, `"zoom-in"`, `"zoom-out"`
